subject.title: openclaw doctor should detect stale gateway lock files

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open fork PR, or close it and replace it with a narrow current-main OpenClaw PR for gateway-lock doctor coverage?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and narrow, but an open conflicting fork PR still claims the closing fix, so automation should not create a second fix path until maintainers choose ownership for that branch.

options.title: Replace the stale fork branch
options.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and let a fresh narrow PR implement the check against current doctor-health and gateway-lock contracts.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork work
options.body: A maintainer can manually port the useful fork diff onto current main, preserve contributor credit, and close the stale fork after replacement exists.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Leave the issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase and provide current proof before any new fix lane starts.

recommendation.title: Replace the stale fork branch
recommendation.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and let a fresh narrow PR implement the check against current doctor-health and gateway-lock contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent doctor health-check contract work is the closest owner boundary for deciding the current implementation shape.
